svg.text: ! used by octal PSRAM (N16R8) — do not use
Grey wire = audio ground (GND_A). Wire pads are on the sides of the terminal board, away from the ESP32 antenna.
⚠ Keep the IN-OUT solder jumper OPEN: it bypasses the diode between USB VBUS and 5V.
Bridged, the 5 V from the buck converter would reach the PC over USB.
